# Markdown and Mermaid distributions

The extension loads these files from its own installation. The browser bundles are copied unmodified from the pinned npm packages.

| Local file | npm package | Path in package | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown-it-15.0.3.mjs` | [markdown-it@15.0.3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/markdown-it/v/15.0.3) | `dist/browser/markdown-it.esm.min.mjs` | `d5432491790141da046b1197353705db03264f40b5727f3b4b591f5aba193e30` |
| `mermaid-12.3.0.js` | [mermaid@12.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mermaid/v/12.3.0) | `dist/mermaid.min.js` | `336df803d87a38b70a01e736e666c8f7601d2ce42f5e47c8fafe5d721074b9a3` |

License texts from the packages and their npm dependencies are in [markdown-mermaid-NOTICES.txt](markdown-mermaid-NOTICES.txt).
